Muse Installer 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- One-click installation and onboarding for Muse via Agent, requiring no terminal use.
- Full automated process: environment check, code download, dependency installation, service launching, and UI introduction.
- Guides user through a 3-question onboarding to collect personal "DNA" for content recommendations.
- Analyzes user's top 10 platform posts (if provided) to generate a personalized creative profile.
- Syncs all setup and DNA info to the Muse dashboard and instructs on browser extension installation.
- Includes troubleshooting commands and optional Telegram Bot integration.
